Genshin Impact's own voice actors join backlash at lack of representation in new region Natlan's character designs
==================================================================================================================

"You still got time to fix it."

         ![Image 1: Mavuika from Genshin Impact.](https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/HoYoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-Genshin-Impact's-Natlan-character-designs-cover.jpg?width=570&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp)

Image credit: HoYoverse

![Image 3: Jessica Orr avatar](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)

News by [Jessica Orr](https://www.eurogamer.net/authors/jessica-orr) Senior Guides Writer

Published on July 15, 2024

[46 comments](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs?view=comments)

Follow Genshin Impact

[Genshin Impact](https://www.eurogamer.net/games/genshin-impact) has once again been accused of cultural appropriation from fans and voice actors in response to the reveal of its new cast of Natlan characters.

Every region in Genshin Impact draws heavy inspiration from real world countries and cultures, basing each region's general design, mythology, and music on these various real-world areas. Inazuma is representative of Japan, Fontaine of France, Mondstadt of Germany and the Netherlands, and so on.

Based on its character and region names, established mythology, and glimpses of what the area looks like in trailers, the upcoming Natlan region looks set to take great inspiration from countries and cultures in both Africa and the Ring of Fire area surrounding the Pacific Ocean, which includes Latin America and Aboriginal Australian cultures. But fans say that this isn't reflected in Natlan's character designs, and now the game's voice actors have joined in the criticism via social media.

"I really hope that a video game company listens to its fanbase when valid criticism is made multiple years in a row about the execution of its research and inclusion of elements/aspects of other cultures," said [Anne Yatco](https://x.com/annejyatco/status/1812215122888437830), who voices Raiden Shogun in the game.

To see this content please enable targeting cookies. Manage cookie settings

Valeria Rodríguez, who voices Sucrose, [shared a similar sentiment](https://x.com/ElvisBadger/status/1811938029709496606): "If you're going to use real-world deities, RESPECT them. If you're basing off of real cultures, RESPECT THAT. I'm fine with things being inspired by various cultures - that's awesome. Representation is dope. But bare minimum do some research and show some cultural appreciation."

Rodríguez also compared Genshin Impact's representation of Ọlọrun, the supreme Yoruba deity, with that seen in popular MOBA [Smite](https://www.eurogamer.net/games/smite), showing the stark contrast of skin colour between the two. "This is unforgivable. Look at what a sick job Smite did with their own interpretation!!! IT'S NOT HARD!!!"

Alejandro Saab, who voices Cyno in Genshin Impact and Jing Yuan in [Honkai: Star Rail](https://www.eurogamer.net/games/honkai-star-rail), retweeted Rodríguez's Smite comparison, adding "You still got time to fix it", presumably addressing Genshin Impact developer HoYoverse.

Eurogamer has contacted HoYoverse for comment.

Genshin Impact's Albedo voice actor, Khoi Dao, also [addressed Ọlọrun's representation](https://x.com/khoidaooo/status/1812140177126723759): "If a game draws so heavily from real-world cultures, and bases a character on the supreme deity of Yoruba religion, and that character ends up looking like pale sasuke Batman, people are absolutely within their rights to demand better representation, ESPECIALLY when said game has a clearly-stated commitment to a \*global\* audience. I hope y'all keep making your voices heard, and I hope they listen."

This isn't the first time Genshin Impact has been called out by fans for its overwhelmingly light-skinned cast of characters, as the same criticisms have been continually made against Sumeru, a nation with heavy South Asian, Middle Eastern, and North African influences. However, this is the first time so many prominent HoYoverse voice actors have spoken up, which seems to have brought more attention to the issue.

![Image 5: Voice actor reveal for Xilonen in Genshin Impact.](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)

1 of 4

![Image 7: Voice actor reveal for Xilonen in Genshin Impact.](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)![Image 9: Voice actor reveal for Kinich in Genshin Impact.](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)![Image 11: Voice actor reveal for Citlali in Genshin Impact.](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)![Image 13: Voice actor reveal for Chasca in Genshin Impact.](https://www.eurogamer.net/hoyoverse-voice-actors-speak-out-over-lack-of-diversity-in-genshin-impact-natlan-character-designs)

Caption

Attribution

Some of Natlan's characters.

The hashtag 'BoycottHYV' has been steadily gaining momentum on X since the Natlan character reveal, which fans are using to share their frustrations, petitions, and character redesigns. HoYoverse has yet to respond, and has continued to post Natlan character teases on their social media. The company isn't known for addressing controversies, but with Chinese players and its own voice actors criticising Natlan's characters, fans believe the company may be more likely to respond than usual.

Zeno Robinson, who voices Sethos in Genshin Impact, [sums up](https://x.com/childishgamzeno/status/1812108021050318922) the worldwide dissatisfaction with Natlan's characters well: "If even your base audience, the Chinese fans, are asking for better representation/or character\[s\] with different shades of melanin, who are you making these characters for?"

15.content:
New Genshin Impact region is the latest to be criticized for cultural appropriation.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Genshin Impact is facing more accusations of cultural appropriation and whitewashing, and some of its voice actors are asking publisher HoYoverse to make changes.

The ever-expanding Genshin Impact universe features stories and locations seemingly inspired by the real world. Similarities range from the geography of in-game settings to architecture, mythology, music, food, and history in general. These connections have been extended to a new region, Natlan, which was [revealed in a trailer released last week](https://www.ign.com/videos/genshin-impact-official-a-name-forged-in-flames-ignition-teaser-trailer).

Fan outcry stems from what many feel is a failure to accurately represent the cultures each character pulls from, including the fact that Mavukia, Kinich, and Ororon — who seem to be inspired by real-life deities like the Maori's Mahuika — are all white. It continues a trend in Genshin Impact that has seen players begging for proper representation.

Now some of the actors behind Genshin Impact’s faces have begun to chime in. Albedo actor, Khoi Dao, published [a statement on X/Twitter](https://x.com/khoidaooo/status/1812140177126723759) calling for change in Genshin Impact.

"I hope y’all keeping make your voices heard, and I hope they listen.

“If a game draws so heavily from real-world cultures and bases a character on the supreme deity of Yoruba religion, and that character ends up looking like pale Sasuke Batman, people are absolutely within their rights to demand better representation, ESPECIALLY when said game has a clearly-stated commitment to a \*global\* audience.”

Dao continued: "I hope y’all keeping make your voices heard, and I hope they listen."

Zeno Robinson, who voices the recently released Genshin Impact character Sethos, also [called out HoYoverse](https://x.com/childishgamzeno/status/1812108021050318922), highlighting a worldwide desire for better representation.

“If even your base audience, the Chinese fans, are asking for better representation/or character with different shades of melanin, who are you making these characters for?” Robinson said.

> Ọlọrun Is the supreme Yoruba deity. You could find that with a quick Google search, even.  
> This is unforgivable. Look at what a sick job SMITE did with their own interpretation!!! IT’S NOT HARD!!! [pic.twitter.com/LbP3nuT3MK](https://t.co/LbP3nuT3MK)
> 
> — Valeria Rodríguez 🍉 (@ElvisBadger) [July 13, 2024](https://twitter.com/ElvisBadger/status/1811948052321829138?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Sucrose actor Valeria Rodríguez brought more attention to the issue with [a string of posts](https://x.com/ElvisBadger/status/1811938029709496606), too. One post compares Olorun’s appearance in Titan Forge Games’ MOBA title, Smite, to their appearance in Genshin Impact, saying, “Look at what a sick job SMITE did with their own interpretation!!! IT’S NOT HARD!!!”

"It shouldn’t be a radical desire to want to see yourself reflected in the media you consume," Yoimiya actress [Jenny Yokobori said](https://x.com/JennyYokobori/status/1812184758291767484) in her own post.

Natlan hasn’t been officially added to the Genshin Impact universe yet and has no release date. With there still time between now and its launch, Cyno actor Alejandro Saab [took note of the complaints](https://x.com/KaggyFilms/status/1811966018018767309) surrounding Ororon and put out a request to the HoYoverse team.

“I didn’t know THAT’S who he’s based on… AH that’s bad,” Saab said. “You still got time to fix it.”

> there is so much beauty in the world—so many stories that can be told or drawn from, and when it’s not done to its full extent it ends up feeling disrespectful, even if that isn’t the intent. I hope it’s possible to make changes at this stage.
> 
> — Allegra Clark (@SimplyAllegra) [July 13, 2024](https://twitter.com/SimplyAllegra/status/1812228518547431898?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Anne Yatco, who plays Genshin Impact’s Raiden Shogun, [added](https://x.com/annejyatco/status/1812215122888437830), “I really hope that a video game company listens to its fanbase when valid criticism is made multiple years in a row about the execution of its research and inclusion of elements/aspects of other cultures.”

[Genshin Impact released in 2020](https://www.ign.com/articles/genshin-impact-review) and has continued to build on its foundation with new locations and characters in the years since. HoYoverse has yet to respond to calls for better representation. IGN has reached out for comment.

_Michael Cripe is a freelance contributor with IGN. He started writing in the industry in 2017 and is best known for his work at outlets such as The Pitch, The Escapist, OnlySP, and Gameranx._

### GamesRadar+ Verdict

For all its gorgeous regions, hard-hitting quests, and inventive combat tricks, Genshin Impact's greatest achievement is preparing an open-world RPG experience so sumptuous that it overcomes the towering wall imposed by inalienably predatory free-to-play gacha mechanics.

[Check Amazon](https://target.georiot.com/Proxy.ashx?tsid=8426&GR_URL=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.co.uk%2Fs%2Fref%3Dnb_sb_noss%3Fa%3Db%26field-keywords%3DGenshin+Impact%26tag%3Dhawk-future-21%26ascsubtag%3Dgrd-gb-1284033658783978522-21)

#### Pros

*   +Gorgeous and creative open world
    
*   +Clever elemental combat system
    
*   +Enormous cast of likable characters
    

#### Cons

*   \-Heavily time-gated progression
    
*   \-Outdated daily and banner limitations
    
*   \-Huge mobile storage demands
    

Why you can trust GamesRadar+ Our experts review games, movies and tech over countless hours, so you can choose the best for you. [Find out more about our reviews policy.](https://www.gamesradar.com/reviews-policy/)

Let me show you the kind of sentence I look forward to after 10 years of game journalism. Genshin Impact feels built for console and PC but also looks great and runs well on your mobile phone. A colder take would be hard to produce, but this is an important part of Genshin Impact's legacy. The best mobile games have been so good for so long that it's rare to get that kind of surprise anymore, that technological whiplash and disbelief, but Genshin Impact can still pull it off. What a treat. It's an exceptional open-world action RPG despite several progression and monetization hangups endemic to the free-to-play gacha space that Genshin helped revolutionize. It is quite simply some of the most and purest fun you can have on a phone in 2024.

It's hard to evaluate Genshin Impact purely by the standards of either open-world or gacha games, in part because there are two distinct ways to experience it. Treat it as a normal, premium open-world game and you'll find hundreds of hours of adventure waiting. Explore the rich, colorful world to unearth secrets and side quests, complete combat challenges, solve puzzles, and collect materials. Blast through the main quests to unroll the origins of that world and the journey of your hero, one of two blonde, otherworldly twins chosen at the start of the game. Absorb one of the most diverse orchestral soundtracks to ever grace a video game. Cozy up to dozens of memorable characters that would fit right into an anime – cute and cool and tragic, sometimes all at once.

From hours to years 
--------------------

![Image 11: Genshin Impact 5.0 Natlan characters and environments](https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sNh8suoYWsJoCHvePemkg.jpg)

(Image credit: HoYoverse)

Fast Facts - Genshin Impact

**Release date**: September 28, 2020  
**Platform(s)**: Android, iOS  
**Developer**: In-house  
**Publisher**: HoYoverse

Approach Genshin Impact as a live-service, gacha-first experience, however, and you'll find a whole other beast that can devour years of playtime and, if you let it, inadvisable amounts of money. (For the record, I spend less than $15 a month on it.) You can only explore that world and complete those quests once – so please, savor it – and once you run out of _new_ content, _repeatable_ content becomes your home. Which rare characters and weapons are on the current, rotating rate-up banners? How many days do I have to try and pull them? Should I pull my favorite characters or the strongest ones? (Always your favorites.) Which unflinchingly stingy equipment or resource domain will soak up my daily allowance of time-gated Resin? Did I finish the events and claim all the rewards? Have I done my daily challenges? My weeklies? My _monthlies_?

There is no need to engage with Genshin Impact on this level, and you'll know pretty quickly if you want to. You have to _love_ this game to put up with its barbaric RNG and find some kernel of fun in the smallest upgrades and unlocks. I've been doing it for four years, and I'll keep doing it, not just because there is unassailable brilliance under those grindy trappings, but because Genshin's gacha bones don't obstruct the moment-to-moment delights.

![Image 12: Genshin Impact character Mualani](https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PfNRRMdRqYU9sVyzRnwJPP.jpg)

(Image credit: HoYoverse)

Strip away the math that definitely tickles _my_ brain, and the updates that I can only experience once, and there are still two things that keep me coming back to Genshin Impact after thousands of hours. The big one is a third-person, element-infused combat system that's almost too good for its own good. That is damning with fine praise, but this system is crying out for a full-fat, buy-to-play game that can just let loose, player retention be damned. It's that strong. Building a team of four characters presents a fascinating balance of skills and attacks, plus healing and shields. The secret sauce is the way you layer the elements of this world – fire, water, wind, earth, lightning, nature, and ice, for simplicity – to trigger inventive, explosive reactions.

More than anything, it's a pleasure to see Genshin Impact evolve and improve year over year, and to feel those improvements in regular play. The world design and storytelling, especially, are worlds apart from 1.0. The latest patch, version 5.0, is handily the best and most approachable one yet. So you don't have to spend any money, you don't have to worry about any monthlies, and you definitely don't have to do any math. Genshin Impact is a game. Play it! It's a _fabulous_ world, a fantastical concoction of delicious oceans and enchanted forests, obsidian mountains in the jaws of violet lightning and deserts hiding ancient ruins under paws of sand. Drink it in. Chug it down! And if you've had your fill, if there's no more new content and the repeatable stuff doesn't do it for you, put it away – until the next update or forever, knowing you've had your fun and that it somehow didn't cost you a dime.

21.content:
We call on MiHoYo to stop cultural appropriation and whitewashing in their games and to commit to respectful and accurate representation of all cultures.

_Translations below!_

**Background**

MiHoYo, a leading game development company, has repeatedly taken inspiration from indigenous cultures without proper representation and respect. In particular, the many characters from Sumeru and Natlan in Genshin Impact, and from Penacony in Honkai Star Rail are _all_ clearly white or only lightly tanned at best, with the exception of some enemy NPCs which has sparked concerns of racism among players and indigenous communities.

**The Problem**

Cultural appropriation and whitewashing perpetuate harmful stereotypes and diminish the rich cultural heritage of indigenous communities. These practices not only misrepresent cultures but also contribute to ongoing marginalization and disrespect.

**The Solution**

We urge MiHoYo to:

*   Engage with indigenous cultural consultants.
*   Revise existing content to ensure accurate representation.
*   Commit to creating diverse and inclusive characters.

**Act now!**

Sign this petition to demand that MiHoYo takes immediate action to address these issues. If we act now, we have a chance to make a difference before Natlan's release.

Share this petition with your friends, family, and social networks to amplify our message!

**Thank you!**

Thank you for your support. Together, we can ensure that all cultures are represented with respect and accuracy in gaming.

 ____

我们呼吁 MiHoYo 停止在其游戏中进行文化挪用和粉饰，并承诺尊重和准确地表现所有文化。

**背景介绍**

MiHoYo 是一家领先的游戏开发公司，曾多次从土著文化中汲取灵感，却没有适当地表现和尊重土著文化。尤其是《原神》中来自须弥和纳塔的许多角色，以及《崩坏：星穹铁道》中来自匹诺康尼的许多角色，除了一些敌方 NPC 外，都是明显的白人或最多只是浅肤色，这引发了玩家和原住民社区对种族主义的担忧。

**问题所在**

文化挪用和粉饰延续了有害的刻板印象，削弱了原住民社区丰富的文化遗产。这些做法不仅歪曲了文化，还造成了持续的边缘化和不尊重。

**解决方案**

我们敦促 MiHoYo

与原住民文化顾问合作。

修改现有内容，确保准确表达。

致力于创造多样化和包容性的角色。

**立即行动！**

签署这份请愿书，要求 MiHoYo 立即采取行动解决这些问题。如果我们现在就行动起来，就有机会在 Natlan 上映之前改变现状。

与您的朋友、家人和社交网络分享这份请愿书，扩大我们的信息！

**感谢您的支持！**

感谢您的支持。团结起来，我们就能确保所有文化在游戏中都得到尊重和准确的体现。

____ 

**署名運動について**

今や世界的に知られているゲーム開発会社のMiHoYo は今まで数多くの先住民族の文化から影響のある作品を作っているのにもかかわらず、彼らの文化や多様性を尊重した扱いをしていません。

特に問題なのは原神インパクトのスメールやナタ、および崩壊スターレイルのピノコニーで登場する人物だと思われます。

主人公キャラたちの肌は白、稀に薄い褐色であるのに、敵キャラやNPCのみ肌が黒く、ゲーム内舞台となる国参考となった現実のロケーションに暮らす人々を忠実に表しているように見えます。

これらのデザイン判断は人種差別的かつ先住民族に対しての差別ではないかと疑問の声があげられています。

**問題**

文化の盗用は先住民族や人種的少数派に対して悪的なステレオタイプを生み出し、彼らの純正な文化や遺産を減少させてしまう行為です。 これらの行動は彼らの文化を不適切に表し、今現代現実でも続く疎外化や差別につながります。

**解決策**

MiHoYo にこれらのことを要求します:

-先住民族に文化の表し方について相談すること

-以前までのコンテンツを彼らの文化を忠実に表すように見直すこと

-今後も多様性深いキャラクターを作り続けること

**署名のお願い**

MiHoYo により早く行動を要求するため、この署名運動への参加をお願いします。今ならナタリリース前に間に合うかもしれません。

友達、家族、SNSなどにもシェアしていただけるとなお効果的です。

**礼**

皆様にサポートしていただき、ありがとうございます。

共に世界すべての文化と多様性を忠実にリスペクトを持ってゲームなどのメディアで楽しみましょう。

 ____

**배경**

게임 개발사 미호요(MiHoYo)는 적절한 표현과 존중 없이 원주민 문화에서 영감을 반복적으로 받아왔습니다. 특히, 원신의 수메르와 나타 및 붕괴:스타레일의 페나코니에 있는 많은 캐릭터들은 NPC를 제외하고 모두 완전히 흰색이거나 기껏해야 약간 그을린 피부색입니다. 이것은 원주민 커뮤니티와 플레이어들 사이에 인종차별에 대한 우려를 불러일으켰습니다.

**문제**

문화적 도용과 화이트워싱(whitewashing)는 해로운 고정관념을 영속시키며, 원주민 공동체의 풍부한 문화유산을 약화시킵니다. 이러한 관행은 문화를 왜곡할 뿐만 아니라 지속적인 소외와 무례함을 조장합니다.

**해결책**

우리는 미호요에게 다음을 촉구합니다:

원주민 문화에 소속된 컨설턴트와 협력해야한다.

정확한 표현을 위해 기존 콘텐츠를 수정해야한다.

다양하고 포용적인 캐릭터를 만들기 위해 노력해야한다.

**지금 행동해주세요!**

미호요가 이러한 문제를 해결하기 위해 즉각적인 조치를 취할 것을 요구하려면 이 청원서에 서명하세요. 지금 행동한다면 나타가 출시되기 전에 우리는 변화를 만들 수 있습니다

이 청원서를 친구, 가족, 소셜 네트워크와 공유하여 우리의 메시지를 널리 알려주세요!

**읽어주셔서 감사합니다!**

귀하의 지원에 감사합니다. 우리는 함께 게임에서 모든 문화가 존중 될 수 있도록 노력해야합니다.

____

**Contexto**

MiHoYo, una empresa líder en el desarrollo de videojuegos, en repetidas ocasiones ha tomado inspiración de culturas indígenas sin haberlas representado de forma apropiada o respetuosa. Especialmente los personajes de Sumeru y Natlan en Genshin Impact además de los de Colonipenal en Honkai: Star Rail, todos son obviamente blancos o sólo ligeramente bronceados, con las excepciones de algunos PNJ los cuales han generado preocupaciones sobre racismo entre los jugadores y comunidades indígenas.

**El problema**

La apropiación cultural y el blanqueo perpetúa estereotipos dañinos y disminuye el gran patrimonio cultural de las comunidades indígenas. Esta clase de prácticas no solo tergiversan las culturas sino que también contribuyen a la continua falta de respeto y marginalización de las mismas.

**La solución**

Pedimos a MiHoYo que:

*   Colaboré con asesores culturales indígenas.
*   Revise el contenido ya existente para asegurarse de una representación correcta.
*   Que se comprometa a crear personajes diversos e inclusivos.

**¡Hazlo ya!**

Firma esta petición y pide a MiHoYo que tome medidas inmediatas al respecto. Si hacemos algo ahora, tenemos la posibilidad de hacer un cambio antes de que salga Natlan. ¡Comparte esta petición con tus amigos, familia y redes sociales para ampliar nuestro mensaje!

**¡Gracias!**

Gracias por tu apoyo. Juntos podemos asegurar que todas las culturas sean representadas con respeto y fidelidad en los videojuegos.

 ____

نحن ندعو MiHoYo إلى وقف الاستيلاء الثقافي وتبييض البشرة في ألعابهم والالتزام بالتمثيل المحترم والدقيق لجميع الثقافات.

**الخلفية**

لقد استلهمت شركة MiHoYo، وهي شركة رائدة في تطوير الألعاب، مرارًا وتكرارًا من ثقافات الشعوب الأصلية دون تمثيلها واحترامها بشكل صحيح. وعلى وجه الخصوص، العديد من الشخصيات من سوميرو وناتلان في لعبة Genshin Impact، ومن بيناكوني في لعبة Honkai Star Rail كلها بيضاء بشكل واضح أو ذات بشرة سمراء خفيفة في أحسن الأحوال، باستثناء بعض الشخصيات غير القابلة للعب من الأعداء مما أثار مخاوف العنصرية بين اللاعبين ومجتمعات السكان الأصليين.

**المشكلة**

الاستلاب الثقافي والتبييض يديم الصور النمطية الضارة ويقلل من التراث الثقافي الغني لمجتمعات السكان الأصليين. هذه الممارسات لا تشوه الثقافات فقط، بل تساهم أيضًا في استمرار التهميش وعدم الاحترام.

**الحل**

نحن نحث MiHoYo على:

الانخراط مع مستشارين ثقافيين من السكان الأصليين.

مراجعة المحتوى الحالي لضمان التمثيل الدقيق.

الالتزام بإنشاء شخصيات متنوعة وشاملة.

**تحركوا الآن!**

وقعوا على هذه العريضة لمطالبة MiHoYo باتخاذ إجراءات فورية لمعالجة هذه القضايا. إذا تحركنا الآن، فلدينا فرصة لإحداث فرق قبل إطلاق ناتلان.

شارك هذا الالتماس مع أصدقائك وعائلتك وشبكات التواصل الاجتماعي لتضخيم رسالتنا!

**شكرًا لكم!**

شكراً لكم على دعمكم. معًا، يمكننا ضمان تمثيل جميع الثقافات باحترام ودقة في الألعاب.

 ____

Nous appelons MiHoYo à arrêter l'appropriation culturelle et le whitewashing dans leur jeux et de faire des représentations respectueuse et précises de chaque cultures.

**Contexte**

MiHoYo, une compagnie leader de développement de jeux, a répétivement pris inspiration de cultures autochtones/indigènes sans bonnes représentations appropriée ou respect. En particulier, plusieurs personnages de Sumeru et Natlan de Genshin Impact, et de Penacony de Honkai Star Rail sont tous clairement blancs ou un peu bronzé au mieux, avec pour l'exception quelques PNJ ennemis ce qui a éveillé des suspicions et préoccupations de racisme à travers les joueurs et des communautés autochtones/indigènes.

**Le problème**

L'appropriation culturelle et le whitewashing perpétuent et consistuent des stéréotypes nocifs et diminuent le riche héritage culturel des communautés autochtones/indigènes. Ces pratiques non seulement représentent mal les cultures mais aussi contribuent à la persistante marginalisation et à l'irrespect.

**La solution**

Nous invitons MiHoYo à:

*   Engager avec des connaisseurs des cultures indigènes/autochtones.
*   Réviser le contenu existant pour assurer la représentation cohérente et précise.
*   Se commettre à créer des personnages divers et inclusifs.

**Agissez maintenant !**

Signez cette pétition pour demander à ce que MiHoYo prenne action immédiate pour adresser ces problèmes. Si nous agissons maintenant, nous avons une chance de faire une différence avant la sortie finale de Natlan. Partagez cette pétition à vos amis, famille, et réseaux sociaux pour amplifier notre message !

**Merci !**

Merci pour votre soutient. Ensemble, on peut s'assurer que toutes les cultures soient représentées avec respect et précision dans le gaming.

 ____

**Contexto**

MiHoYo, uma empresa líder no desenvolvimento de jogos, vem repetidamente se inspirando em culturas indígenas sem a correta representação e respeito. Particularmente, vários dos personagens de Sumeru e de Natlan em Genshin Impact, e de Penacony em Honkai Star Rail, são claramente brancos ou levemente bronzeados, na melhor das hipóteses, com algumas exceções sendo NPCs, o que desencadeou preocupações de racismo entre os jogadores e em comunidades indígenas.

**O Problema**

Cultural appropriation and whitewashing perpetuate harmful stereotypes and diminish the rich cultural heritage of indigenous communities. These practices not only misrepresent cultures but also contribute to ongoing marginalization and disrespect.

A apropriação cultural e o embranquecimento perpetuam estereótipos nocivos e diminuem a vasta herança cultural das comunidades indígenas. Essas práticas não só deturpam tais culturas como também contribuem para a contínua marginalização e desrespeito.

**A Solução**

Nós exigimos que a MiHoYo:

*   Contrate consultores culturais indígenas.
*   Revise conteúdos já existentes para garantir sua correta representação.
*   Comprometa-se a criar personagens inclusivos e diversos.

**Aja agora!**

Assine essa petição e exija que a MiHoYo tome medidas imediatamente para resolver esses problemas. Se agirmos agora, nós temos a chance de fazer uma diferença antes do lançamento de Natlan.

Compartilhe essa petição com seus amigos, família e redes sociais para amplificar nossa mensagem!

**Obrigado!**

Muito obrigado pelo seu suporte. Juntos, nós podemos garantir que todas as culturas sejam representadas com respeito e precisão nos jogos!

 ____

**Geçmiş**

Mihoyo, lider bir oyun geliştirme şirketi, defalarca yöreye özgü kültürleri doğruca ve saygılı bir şekilde yansıtmadan onlardan ilham almıştır. Hatta, Genshin Impact’in Sumeru ve Natlan karakterleri ve Honkai Star Rail’in Penacony karakterleri bariz bir şekilde beyaz veya açık tenlidir, sadece düşman NPClerin açık tenli veya beyaz olmaması bu kültürlere özgün toplumlarda ırkçılığa dair endişe yarattı.

**Sorun**

Kültür yağmacılığı ve whitewashing (beyaz olmayan bir karakterin özelliklerinin yok edilmesi ve adeta öyle bir karaktermiş gibi lanse edilmesi.) zarar verici klişeleri devam ettirir ve yerli toplulukların zengin kültürel mirasını azaltır. Bu çalışmalar bir kültürü sadece yanlış tanıtmakla kalmaz, ayrıca devam eden marjinalleşmeye ve saygısızlığa katkıda bulunur.

**Çözüm**

MiHoYo’nun bunları yapmasını teşvik ediyoruz:

* Yerli kültür danışmanlarıyla iletişim kurmaları.

* (Kültürleri) doğru tanıttıklarından emin olmak için var olan içerikleri gözden geçirmelerini.

* Farklı ve kapsayıcı karakterler yaratmakta kararlı kalmalarını.

**Şimdi harekete geçin!**

MiHoYo’nun hızlıca harekete geçip bu sorunu ele almasını talep etmek için bu kampanyayı imzalayın. Şimdi harekete geçersek, Natlan yayınlanmadan önce bir değişiklik sağlamamız için şansımız var.

Mesajımızı güçlendirmek için bu kampanyayı arkadaşlarınızla, ailenizle ve sosyal mecralarda paylaşın!

**Teşekkürler**

Desteğiniz için teşekkür ederiz. Beraber, tüm kültürlerin oyunlarda doğru ve saygıyla temsil edildmesini sağlayabiliriz.

____

Wij roepen MiHoYo op om de culturele toe-eigening en het witwassen in hun games te stoppen en om zich in te zetten voor respectvolle en nauwkeurige representaties van alle culturen waarvan zij inspiratie hebben genomen.

**Achtergrond**

MiHoYo, een groot computerspelontwikkelend bedrijf, heeft herhaaldelijks inspiratie genomen van inheemse culturen zonder de juiste representatie en met een gebrek aan respect. Met name de vele personages van Sumeru en Natlan in Genshin Impact, Penacony in Honkai: Star Rail zijn allemaal overduidelijk wit in huidskleur en ras, of op zijn best lichtelijk getint. Met als uitzondering vijandige NPCs wat heeft aangezet tot bezorgdheden over racisme onder de spelers en inheemse gemeenschappen.

**Het Probleem**

Culturele toe-eigening en witwassen zetten schadelijke stereotypen voort, en nemen af van de rijke culturele nalatenschap van inheemse gemeenschappen. Deze werkwijze zorgt er niet alleen voor dat vele culturen verkeerd voorgesteld worden, maar dragen ook bij aan de voortdurende verkleining van deze culturen en het disrespect naar hun toe.

**De Oplossing**

Wij verzoeken MiHoYo dringend om:

*   In gesprek te gaan/Samen te gaan werken met inheemse culturele adviseurs.
*   Bestaande content te herzien om er zeker van te zijn dat de representatie accuraat is.
*   Te beloven om diverse en inclusieve personages te maken.

**Kom nu in actie!**

Teken deze petitie om MiHoYo te eisen dat ze onmiddellijk actie ondernemen om deze problemen aan te pakken. Als wij nu in actie komen, is er nog een kans om een verschil te maken voordat Natlan uitkomt.

Deel deze petitie met uw vrienden, familie en sociale netwerken om ons bericht te versterken!

**Dankuwel!**

Dank u voor uw ondersteuning. Samen kunnen wij ervoor zorgen dat alle culturen met respect en nauwkeurigheid worden gerepresenteerd in gaming.

____

Hiermit möchten wir MiHoYo aufrufen, mit der kulturellen Aneignung und der Weißwaschung in Ihren Spielen aufzuhören und stattdessen eine respektvolle und anständige Repräsentation aller Kulturen zu pflegen.

**Der Hintergrund**

MiHoYo, ein führendes Unternehmen für Spieleentwicklung, nimmt seit einiger Zeit inspiration von Indigenen Kulturen, ohne akkurate Repräsentation oder Respekt zu zeigen.

Insbesondere sind davon die vielen Charaktere von den Regionen Sumeru und Natlan in Genshin Impact, und die Charaktere in Penacony in Honkai Star Rail gemeint. Diese sind alle eindeutig Weiß oder lediglich leicht gebräunt. Ausnahmen darin liegen nur bei einigen Gegner-NSC. Dies hat Sorgen über Rassismus unter Spielern und Indigenen Gemeinschaften ausgelöst.

**Das Problem**

Kulturelle Aneignung und Weißwaschung verewigen schädliche Stereotypen und verringern das Reiche kulturelle Erbe der Indigenen Gemeinschaften. Solche Vorgehen stellen nicht nur Kulturen falsch dar, sondern tragen auch zu anhaltender Ausgrenzung und Respektlosigkeit bei.

**Die Lösung**

Wir forden MiHoYo auf:

*   mit Indigenen Kulturberatern zusammen zu arbeiten
*   ⁠vorhandene Inhalte zu überarbeiten, um eine korrekte Darstellung zu gewährleisten -
*   ⁠sich für die Schaffung vielfältiger und integrativer Charaktere einzusetzen

**Handle jetzt!**

Unterschreibe diese Petition um zu fordern, dass MiHoYo sofort Maßnahmen ergreift, um diese Probleme anzugehen. Wenn wir jetzt handeln, haben wir die Chance, vor Natlans Veröffentlichung etwas zu bewirken.

Teile diese Petition mit deinen Freunden, deiner Familie und Sozialen Netzwerken, um unsere Nachricht zu verstärken!

**Vielen Dank !**

Vielen Dank für deine Unterstützung. Zusammen können wir sicherstellen, dass all diese Kulturen mit Respekt und Anständigkeit in Spielen repräsentiert werden.

 ____

Ми закликаємо MiHoYo зупинити присвоєння культур та "відбілення" у своїх іграх та взяти на себе зобов'язання підходити з повагою та точністю до репрезентації всіх культур.

**Передумови**

MiHoYo, провідна компанія з розробки ігор, неодноразово надихалися культурою корінних народів без належної репрезентації та поваги. Зокрема персонажі з Сумеру та Натлану у Genshin Impact та з Пенаконії у Honkai Star Rail всі білошкірі або у найкращому випадку мають лише злегка засмаглу шкіру, за винятком кількох ворожих НІПів, що викликало серед гравців та корінних громад занепокоєння щодо расизму.

**Проблема**

Привласнення культури та "відбілення" докладається до увіковічення шкідливих стереотипів та применшує багату культурну спадщину корінних громад. Ці практики не лише недостовірно репрезентують культури, а також сприяють триваючій маргіналізації та неповазі.

**Рішення**

Ми наполягаємо на тому, щоб MiHoYo:

*   Найняли консультантів з культур корінних народів.
*   Переглянули наявний контент для забезпечення точної культурної репрезентації.
*   Взяли на себе зобов'язання створювати різноманітних та інклюзивних персонажів.

**Починай діяти вже зараз!**

Підпишіть цю петицію з вимогою до MiHoYo вжити негайних заходів для вирішення цих проблем. Якщо почнімо діяти зараз, то матимемо шанс на зміни ще до релізу Натлану.

Поширюйте цю петицію серед своїх друзів, сім'ї та у соц.мережах, щоб збільшити гучність нашого повідомлення!

**Дякуємо!**

Дякуємо за вашу підтримку. Разом ми зможемо забезпечити, щоб всі культури в іграх були репрезентовані з повагою та точністю.

 ____

**წინაპირობა**

MiHoYo-ს წამყვან თამაშს დეველოპერულ კომპანიაში ბევრჯერ აქვს ინსპირაცია აღებული მკვიდრი საზოგადოებისგან ყოველგვარი კულტურულად კარგი წარმოჩენისა და კულტურისადმი პატივისცემის გარეშე. კონკრეტულად, ბევრი პერსონაჟი სუმერუდან და ნათლანიდან Genshin Impact-ში, ასევე, ფენაქონიდან Honkai Star Rail-ში არიან ყველა თეთრკანიანი ან ღია ფერის, მაგრამ მტერი NPC-ები ყოველთვის უფრო მუქად წარმოჩნდებიან, რაც მოთამაშეებში და მკვიდრ საზოგადოებაში აჩენს ფიქრს რომ არის რასიზმი.

**პრობლემა**

კულტურული შეურაცხყოფა და კანის ფერის გათეთრება ავრცელებს საზიანო სტერეოტიპებს და ამცირებს მკვიდრი საზოგადოების მდიდარ კულტურულ მემკვიდრეობას. ეს ყველაფერი არამხოლოდ აყენებს შეურაცხყოფას კულტურას, ისინი ასევე მონაწილეობს ზემოთხსენებული ხალხისადმი უპატივცემულობაში და მათ მარგინალიზაციაში.

**პრობლემის გადაჭრა**

ჩვენ მოვუწოდებთ MiHoYo-ს რომ:

*   ჩაერთეთ ადგილობრივ კულტურულ კონსულტანტებთან.
*   გადახედეთ არსებულ შინაარსს ზუსტი კულტურული წარმოჩენის უზრუნველსაყოფად.
*   მიიღეთ ვალდებულება შექმნათ მრავალფეროვანი და ინკლუზიური პერსონაჟები.

**იმოქმედე ახლა!**

მოაწერეთ ამ პეტიციას ხელი, რომ მოსთხოვოთ MiHoYo-ს დაუყოვნებლივი მოქმედება და მიხედოს ზემოთხსენებულ პრობლემებს. თუ ახლა ვიმოქმედებთ ჩვენ შეგვეძლება შევიტანოთ ცვლილება თამაშში ნათლანის გამოშვებამდე.

გაუზიარეთ ეს პეტიცია თქვენს მეგობრებს, ოჯახის წევრებს და გაავრცელეთ ეს სოციალურ ნეთვორქში, რომ ჩვენი ხმა მიაწვდინოთ საზოგადოებას!

**მადლობა!**

მადლობა თქვენი მხარდაჭერისთვის. ერთად ჩვენ შეგვიძლია დავრწმუნდეთ, რომ ყველა კულტურა იქნება წარმოჩენილი პატივისთემითა და სწორი ელემენტებით თამაშში.

_____

**Contesto**

MiHoYo, una compagnia leader nello sviluppo dei videogiochi, si è ripetutamente ispirata alle culture indigene senza rappresentarle e rispettarle adeguatamente. In particolare, i numerosi personaggi di Sumeru e Natlan in Genshin Impact e di Penacony in Honkai Star Rail sono tutti chiaramente bianchi o al massimo solo leggermente abbronzati, con l'eccezione di alcuni Personaggi Non Giocabili (PNG) nemici, il che ha suscitato preoccupazioni tra i giocatori e nelle comunità indigene circa la presenza di razzismo.

**Il Problema**

L'appropriazione culturale e il whitewashing perpetuano stereotipi dannosi e sminuiscono il ricco patrimonio culturale delle comunità indigene. Queste pratiche non solo travisano le culture, ma contribuiscono anche alla continua marginalizzazione e alla continua mancanza di rispetto.

**La Soluzione**

Chiediamo a MiHoYo di:

*   Collaborare con consulenti culturali indigeni.
*   Rivedere i contenuti esistenti per garantire una rappresentazione accurata.
*   Impegnarsi a creare personaggi diversi e inclusivi.

**Agisci ora!**

Firma la petizione per chiedere a MiHoYo di agire immediatamente per rispondere a queste problematiche. Se agiamo ora, abbiamo la possibilità di fare la differenza prima dell'uscita di Natlan.

Condividi questa petizione con i tuoi amici, familiari e sui social network per diffondere il nostro messaggio!

**Grazie!**

Grazie per il tuo supporto. Assieme, possiamo assicurarci che tutte le culture venga rappresentate con rispetto e accuratezza nei videogiochi.

____

Καλούμε τη MiHoYo να σταματήσει τον πολιτιστικό σφετερισμό και το “whitewashing” στα παιχνίδια της και να δεσμευτεί για σεβασμό και ακριβή εκπροσώπηση όλων των πολιτισμών.

**Γενικό Πλαίσιο**

Η MiHoYo, μια κορυφαία εταιρεία παραγωγής παιχνιδιών, έχει επανειλημμένα εμπνευστεί από ιθαγενείς/αυτόχθονες πολιτισμούς χωρίς σωστή εκπροσώπηση και σεβασμό. Συγκεκριμένα, οι πολλοί χαρακτήρες από τη Sumeru και τη Natlan στο Genshin Impact και από τον κόσμο Penacony στο Honkai Star Rail είναι όλοι καθαρά λευκοί ή μόνο ελαφρώς μαυρισμένοι στην καλύτερη περίπτωση, με εξαίρεση ορισμένων εχθρών(NPC) γεγονός που έχει προκαλέσει ανησυχίες για ρατσισμό, μεταξύ των παικτών και των ιθαγενών κοινοτήτων.

**Το πρόβλημα**

Ο πολιτιστικός σφετερισμός και το whitewashing διαιωνίζουν επιβλαβή στερεότυπα και μειώνουν την πλούσια πολιτιστική κληρονομιά των ιθαγενών κοινοτήτων. Αυτές οι πρακτικές όχι μόνο αντιπροσωπεύουν ψευδώς και διαστρεβλώνουν την εικόνα των πολιτισμών αλλά συμβάλλουν επίσης στη συνεχή περιθωριοποίηση και ασέβεια.

**Η λύση**

Προτρέπουμε τη MiHoYo να:

*   Συνεργαστεί με ιθαγενείς πολιτιστικούς συμβούλους.
*   Αναθεωρήσει το υπάρχον περιεχόμενο για να εξασφαλίσει ακριβή αντιπροσώπευση των πολιτισμών.
*   Δεσμευτεί στη δημιουργία ποικιλόμορφων και συμπεριληπτικών χαρακτήρων.

![Image 1: Genshin Impact character Kachina in front of an overgrown stone temple in the game's Natlan region.](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/genshin-impact-kachina-natlan.jpg?&fit=crop&w=1600&h=900)

[![Image 2: 4](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress%2Fwp-content%2Fauthors%2F644c854db9df0-337014309_1013524496298030_7977088224555329994_n.jpg?fit=crop&w=90&h=90)](https://screenrant.com/author/cgrave/)

Cody is a Gaming Editor at Screen Rant specializing in video game reviews & previews. He is largely responsible for Screen Rant's critical voice and has almost a decade of game journalism experience.

Cody's most played games include: Final Fantasy IX, NieR: Automata, Hades, Genshin Impact, Pentiment, the Judgment series, the Yakuza series, and the Persona series.

Sign in to your ScreenRant account

### Summary

*   Genshin Impact's Natlan expansion introduces new traversal methods that could influence character choices.
*   The addition of characters like Mualani and Kinich, along with Saurians, enhances movement and combat in Version 5.0.
*   The combat in Genshin Impact 5.0 is dynamic and engaging, with new characters offering fresh gameplay experiences.

It's a well-known element of live service games - power creep. The term is most often used to describe a core mechanic getting iterated upon countless times with new releases and content updates to the point that its most current form is a dramatic departure from its past, to the point that the latter is no longer viable. I think [**_Genshin Impact_**](https://screenrant.com/tag/genshin-impact/)'s Natlan expansion is the first time the game has really, truly flirted with that concept, but while _Screen Rant_ attended Gamescom 2024, our two-hour hands-on with the [soon-to-be released Version 5.0](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-50-release-date-characters-banners-natlan/) quickly assuaged those fears.

For those wondering which element of _Genshin Impact_'s soon-to-be newest nation I'm referencing when I discuss the idea of past viability being threatened, it's traversal. Sumeru introduced the grappling hook-style mobility that still characterizes some updates even now, while Fontaine let players dive underwater and explore Teyvat in an entirely new way. Neither of those "threatened" anything's existence or function - they were related to their respective content updates and areas. The new methods of getting around Natlan, however, are tied to both Saurians and characters, which could have a major influence on which _Genshin Impact_ characters to pull for in the future.

 ![Image 3: Genshin Impact's Kinich poses, with the Gamescom ONL logo to the left.](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/genshin-impact-xbox-release-date-new-platform-kinich-gamescom.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=220&h=182&dpr=2)Related

##### [Genshin Impact Is FINALLY Coming To A New Platform This November](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-xbox-release-date-new-platform/ "Genshin Impact Is FINALLY Coming To A New Platform This November")

The action RPG by HoYoverse Genshin Impact will finally make its way to a new platform, allowing a different player base to explore Teyvat.

So while I was worried about what characters like Kachina, Mualani and Kinich might do to overworld team compositions - remember when The Wanderer was supposed to totally change that? - I was also cautiously optimistic that HoYoverse has proven it tries hard to not completely outscale characters or gameplay elements over the years. That patience paid off - _Genshin Impact_'s Natlan design is top-tier, its movement is addictive and fluid, and it's the most fun I've had in-combat and out- since Inazuma.

The Environment Of Genshin Impact 5.0
-------------------------------------

### Natlan Shines With Memorable Verticality & Speed

There is a palpable joy in the world-building of Natlan that is fun to observe, even while playing through it. The environment feels huge and foreboding while simultaneously maintaining that desire to check out what's next over a cliff face or deeper into the water. It's equal parts _Pokémon Scarlet_'s Area Zero and _World of Warcraft_'s Un'Goro Crater in terms of vibes. Lush jungle foliage, rocky outcroppings and a constant reminder that there are plenty of dinosaurs, called Saurians, to be found make it feel fresh.

The real winner here is just how good it feels to get around in _Genshin Impact_ now. There's been a huge investment made into how it feels to move through Natlan as different characters, but there will be a bit of overflow into the past, too. During my playthrough, **I confirmed with the _Genshin Impact_ team that [new characters like Mualani](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-mualani-materials-ascension-talent-farming/) and Kinich can use their movement abilities outside of Natlan**, though they won't have as much uptime thanks to Phlogiston mechanics only living inside the new nation.

If this is the way _Genshin Impact_ is going to handle Version 5.0's movement and having characters designed to make moving in the game world easier and more fun, I think it's smart.

Having surfed enough waves and grapple hooked through the air with Kinich, though, I know that both these characters will be in incredibly high demand. They feel like natural successors to Kazuha, Yelan, and The Wanderer - further iterations on how to change the way players look at the map and explore it, without negating the impacts of those predecessor 5-stars that still have viable team compositions and overworld use. If you want _Genshin Impact_ to really feel different, you'll want to make sure you save your Primogems for Kinich and Mualani.

**Without those characters, though, players can transform into Saurians that do the same thing**, just with a little more clunk and a little less flair. Surfing movement, rock climbing and drilling, and grappling hooks were all available with tribal variants of Saurians, who populate their respective corners of the map and can be inhabited just with the press of a button in a pinch. Overall, if this is the way _Genshin Impact_ is going to handle Version 5.0's movement and having characters designed to make moving in the game world easier and more fun, I think it's smart, maintaining accessibility for F2P players (free-to-play) while giving whales (big spenders) plenty of reason to consider it.

We confirmed with the team that while Saurians might be a bit slower than Mualani or Kinich, and combat with them might be slightly more difficult due to a lack of Elemental Skills/Burst, there is no significant advantage to be gained from having 5-star characters as opposed to the F2P-friendly Saurians.

Genshin Impact 5.0's Combat Might Be Its Best Yet
-------------------------------------------------

### Early Impressions Are Favorable At Gamescom 2024

   ![Image 4: Kachina from Genshin Impact.](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/kachina.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=2)

All the fun exploration in the world would mean very little if _Genshin Impact_'s action-oriented combat lagged behind it. Thankfully, Natlan delivers the goods when it comes to random enemies, who exhibit enough interesting behaviors they won't overstay their welcome. Playing as Natlan characters in a team of Anemo Wanderer, Kachina, Mualani, and Kinich (this was provided to me for the demo - I promise this is not a composition I'd actually run), immediately highlighted how far character kits have come in recent years.

**That's possibly why Anemo Wanderer was there, because wow, does that [_Genshin Impact_ kit ever feel basic](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-best-characters-new-players/) now**. Kachina can pilot her drill to both move around and attack enemies at a quick pace, while Mualani's surfing ability opens up plenty of kiting and fast-paced, duck-and-dodge type fighting. Kinich was the star of the show - his Elemental Skill draws a beeline on an enemy and blasts them with pixelated Dendro energy while also letting him glide around the battlefield using them as a tether.

 ![Image 5: Genshin Impact's Yelan throws a blue die up into the air as she smiles gently.](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/genshin-impact-50-update-5-star-characters-banner-capturing-radiance-yelan.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=220&h=182&dpr=2)Related

##### [Genshin Impact's Featured 5-Star Characters Are About To Get A Lot Easier To Pull](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-5-star-characters-update-capturing-radiance/ "Genshin Impact's Featured 5-Star Characters Are About To Get A Lot Easier To Pull")

A new character banner update arriving with Genshin Impact 5.0 may increase the odds of getting the limited character instead of a standard 5-star.

If these have anything in common, it's that they're deep, fun, and potential build-arounds for those who enjoy their respective features. Combat pacing felt a little bit more frenetic, but it also felt more fluid than it has in years, too, with an ease of movement and repositioning that made my usual team compositions featuring a shielder less of a consideration in my mind. Mualani and Kinich certainly have bloom synergy, too, for what it's worth, though my Anemo and Geo teammates did very little to help me explore that beyond a basic understanding.

As it was a demo, some things were obscured - character ultimate voicelines, for instance - that did hide some of the charm of these new additions. From what I did get to see, though, **combat is trending up in _Genshin Impact_ 5.0**. I tackled two world bosses that had their own fun mechanics, much like those that have come before them.

One needed a Pyro character to incinerate his fruit before he ate it, and since HoYo cruelly didn't provide me with one, I had to simply buckle down for a longer fight. The other would dive into fiery feathers unless a Hydro character disrupted them in time, which Mualani was amazing at thanks to her Elemental Skill's movement speed. Little things mattered and the bosses seem colorful and compelling, much like a lot of Natlan's vibrant atmosphere.

Natlan Passes The Vibe Check
----------------------------

### Genshin Impact 5.0 Might Be A Little Over-The-Top, But It's Fun

   ![Image 6: A Tepetlisaurus and its young in Genshin Impact.](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/tepetlisaurus.jpg?q=49&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=2)

Does it feel a little ridiculous to have a soundtrack that is hip-hop-infused in a prehistoric area? Maybe. Does the culture of Natlan feel like it's wildly disparate in its influences? Definitely. But in my opinion, Natlan is first and foremost fun, and is in love with its own identity enough that it becomes infectious after a little while.

The best example I can give of that unfiltered dynamism is the Graffiti Challenge we were able to play during our Gamescom 2024 hands-on appointment. The event tasked me with checking out the regions each tribe inhabits and then deliberately interacting with smaller, sometimes lesser appreciated _Genshin Impact_ elements to complete some of the requirements. For instance, there was a Natlan-specific Kamera that took pictures of local wildlife as it did different things, like rolled around on its back or stayed stationary, with tasks asking for variety in poses. Another simply required finding a Viewpoint, another lesser-sought-after but fantastic staple of _Genshin_ worldbuilding.

\[Natlan's addition in 5.0\] is the Version Update I've been most excited for since early Sumeru.

Unfortunately, I was barred from checking out the Natlan Archon Quest for fear of spoilers, so I can't comment on how the story has begun to stack up versus some really heavy hitters in Fontaine and Sumeru (and, hell, Inazuma - the HoYoverse narrative team really doesn't miss these days). It's definitely a region with all the trappings of a compelling story, though, thanks to the presence of potential conflict between misunderstandings in cultural differences or priorities in ways of life that could keep things a muddled shade of grey for morality.

I've gone on record as saying there are times when I dread the [_Genshin Impact_ content release schedule](https://screenrant.com/genshin-impact-fix-problems-resin-artifact-grind/). Sometimes it feels like too much for me to keep up with, even though I know it's a good problem to have. Saying that, I'm already blocking off a lot of my free time soon to make sure I tackle Natlan at launch - it's the Version Update I've been most excited for since early Sumeru, and I'm eager to see if it lives up to the pretty picture it painted for itself during my brilliant Gamescom 2024 hands-on time.

   ![Image 7: mixcollage-24-dec-2024-11-06-am-8215.jpg](https://static0.srcdn.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/sharedimages/2024/12/mixcollage-24-dec-2024-11-06-am-8215.jpg?q=49&fit=contain&w=480&dpr=2)
